messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a quick step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and at a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a thorough cleaning (strings, fretboard, body). Replace old strings if needed. | A well‑maintained instrument looks more appealing and shows buyers you’ve cared for it. | | **2. Gather Details** | Note make, model, year, serial number, any upgrades (e.g., new pickups, hardware), and its overall condition (body scratches, fret wear, electronics). | Accurate details build trust and help buyers compare prices. | | **3. Research Market Value** | Check recent sales on Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local music stores. Look at similar models, ages, and conditions. | Knowing the going rate lets you price competitively and avoid over/under‑pricing. | | **4. Take High‑Quality Photos** | Capture the front, back, sides, headstock, bridge, soundhole, and any imperfections. Use natural light and a neutral background. | Good photos attract more views and reduce buyer hesitation. | | **5. Write a Clear Listing** | Include brand, model, year, condition summary, key specs (body wood, neck profile, pickup type), and why you’re selling. Mention any extras (case, strap, extra strings). | A detailed description reduces back‑and‑forth questions and speeds up negotiations. | | **6. Choose Your Platforms** | • **Reverb** – great for musical gear, offers buyer protection.
• **eBay** – broad audience, auction or fixed price options.
• **Craigslist / Facebook Marketplace** – local, no shipping hassles.
• **Local Music Stores** – they may buy outright or consign. | Using multiple sites maximizes exposure; local platforms cut shipping costs. | | **7. Set a Realistic Price** | Start slightly above your target price (e.g., $50 higher) to leave room for negotiation. | Buyers expect to haggle; starting high gives you flexibility. | | **8. Be Responsive & Honest** | Answer inquiries promptly. If there are issues (e.g., a cracked finish), disclose them upfront. | Transparency builds buyer confidence and reduces disputes later. | | **9. Arrange Safe Transactions** | • For local sales, meet in a public place (coffee shop, police station parking lot).
• For shipping, use a reputable carrier (UPS, FedEx) and insure the package. | Safety first—especially when meeting strangers or shipping valuable items. | | **10. Finalize & Transfer Ownership** | Sign a simple bill of sale (include serial number, date, price, both parties’ signatures). Keep a copy for your records. | Protects both parties legally and provides proof of purchase. | ### Quick Tips - **Timing:** Listings posted mid‑week (Tuesday–Thursday) often get more views than weekend posts. - **Negotiation:** Decide beforehand how low you’re willing to go. Stick to your minimum price unless you’re ready to walk away. - **Extras:** Offering a spare case, a set of strings, or a strap can sweeten the deal and justify a higher price. - **Shipping:** If you ship, pack the guitar carefully (foam, bubble wrap, sturdy box). Many buyers prefer local pickup to avoid shipping fees. Good luck! If you have a specific model or brand in mind, let me know and I can help you find comparable listings to fine‑tune your asking price.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice on selling an acoustic guitar. We need to respond with helpful information. There's no tool call needed. Just give them steps: research market value, clean it, take photos, list online (e.g., eBay, Craigslist, Reverb), consider local classifieds, set price, negotiate, meet safely, etc. Also mention condition, brand, age, etc. Provide tips.
